description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'GatekeeperChannel' for communication channels used to perform IPC/RPC calls related to Gatekeeper operations, including methods for sending requests/responses and receiving messages.

classes.name: GatekeeperChannel
classes.description: An abstract interface for synchronous communication channels that handle Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command and GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command and GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel, returning a ManagedMessage.
